function.name: currency_conversion_convert

function.name: calc_absolute_pressure
function.description: Calculates the absolute pressure from gauge and atmospheric pressures.

atm_pressure.description: The atmospheric pressure in atmospheres (atm). Default is 1 atm if not provided. This is a float type value.

gauge_pressure.description: The gauge pressure in atmospheres (atm). Must be provided. This is a float type value.

function.name: calculate_displacement
function.description: Calculates the displacement of an object in motion given initial velocity, time, and acceleration.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds that the object has been in motion. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.
